brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market shows headroom at volume) while qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek as second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for this cap sits at ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. Market verdict says there's modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we should get that lower band given our pharma volumes

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt — no need to push harder

brief.financialLeverage: Empire publishes no financials, so we can't see how healthy or cash-tight they are, and we don't know how big a customer our ₹67.47 L spend is to them. That means we build our case on market data and on lining up a credible second source. Push on price using the market benchmark, but keep the tone cooperative — we need supply continuity and a proven alternate before we can afford to press hard. Our annual spend of ₹67.47 L is material enough to warrant attention, so they'll listen if we show we're serious about alternatives.

evidence.point: Market asking price for the 28 mm cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict flags modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
We spend ₹67.47 L a year with them — enough to warrant volume pricing
HDPE resin import price is running at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material cost floor to reference
Empire publishes no financials, so we're flying blind on their health and our leverage

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; health score B (65/100), revenue ₹2569.83 Cr; top second-source candidate (qualify before RFQ)

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures (a lead to qualify)

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging; broad capability across bottles and caps (a lead to qualify)

risks: We have no financial visibility into Empire — can't gauge how stable they are or how hard we can push without risking supply
Our entire ₹67.47 L rigid-plastic spend rides on one supplier with no qualified second source today
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads only — not yet verified or priced, so don't lean on them in the room
If we push too hard on price without a working alternate, Empire could walk and leave us scrambling
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about moving our cap price toward the ₹0.65–0.80 band the market shows at volume, and we're also starting to qualify a second source to de-risk our rigid-packaging supply.
